summary: Positional offset accumulator: adds each caller parameter to a corresponding baseline struct field and stores the result in an adjacent output field. Reads baselines this+0x4 and this+0xC, writes computed this+0x8 = a3 + this+0x4 and this+0x10 = a2 + this+0xC, and returns the computed this+0x10 value.

operations.description: Compute result = a2 + this+0xC (this[3]), the primary baseline plus incoming delta.
Store a3 + v4 into this+0x8 (this[2]), the second computed output.
Store result into this+0x10 (this[4]), the first computed output.
Return result, the computed primary output.
